meta.name: pre-publish-review
meta.description: Nuclear-grade 12-agent pre-publish release gate. Runs /get-unpublished-changes to detect all changes since last npm release, spawns up to 10 ultrabrain agents for deep per-change analysis, invokes /review-work (orchestrator manual QA plus one gate reviewer) for holistic review, and 1 oracle for overall release synthesis. Runs ONLY when the user explicitly asks for a pre-publish review — a plain publish/release request MUST NOT trigger this; /publish ships directly. Triggers: 'pre-publish review', 'review before publish', 'release review', 'pre-release review', 'ready to publish?', 'can I publish?', 'pre-publish', 'safe to publish', 'publishing review', 'pre-publish check'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 审查发布前的代码改动,提前发现遗留问题
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你发布npm包前想要多智能体全面审查
copy.tagline_en: Review code changes before publishing to npm
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're publishing an npm package and want an AI review before release

howto.what: 你要做发布前审查时,Claude 会先列出上次 npm 发布后的全部改动,再并行启动最多 10 个 ultrabrain 代理逐组深审、1 个 review-work 整体审查和 1 个 oracle 总评估,汇总出各发布层版本建议和阻断项。
howto.when: 只有你明确要求「发布前审查」时才触发,如 “pre-publish review”、“ready to publish?” 等;普通 publish 请求不触发,/publish 直接发布。

say.text: 帮我做一次发布前审查,现在能不能发 npm?
say.note: 会先列出未发布的改动再启动多代理审查。

say.text: 审查一下从上次发版到现在的改动,能发布吗?
say.note: 逐组深审后给出各发布层版本建议。

say.text: 帮我看看这次改动的破坏性变更和版本号该怎么定。
say.note: 由 oracle 代理综合给出 semver 建议。

howto.what_en: When you ask for a pre-publish review, Claude lists changes since the last npm release, then runs up to 10 ultrabrain agents on each group, one review-work review and one oracle synthesis, returning version advice and blockers.
howto.when_en: Triggers only when you explicitly ask for a pre-publish review, e.g. “pre-publish review” or “ready to publish?”. A plain publish/release request does not trigger it; /publish ships directly.

say_en.text: Run a pre-publish review — is this safe to ship to npm?
say_en.note: Lists unpublished changes, then starts the agent review.

say_en.text: Review everything since the last release — can I publish?
say_en.note: Deep per-group review plus version bump advice.

say_en.text: Check the breaking changes and what version bump this needs.
say_en.note: The oracle synthesizes the semver recommendation.
